note: Small RV park near downtown Franklin with mountain views; 7 pull-throughs and 13 back-ins, a fire ring at each site. --Claude
summary: Open year-round. Changed fees $65/$65 (website) -> $53-68 (Campspot one night, Nov 2026; $5 campground fee per stay). Confirmed 30/50-amp full hookups, 20 sites with pull-throughs, laundry, Wi-Fi; added 40-ft max, dump station, Campspot booking with a 2-night minimum seen on November and December weekdays. Base $53 is over the $50 line but within 40 km of Great Smoky Mountains NP (gateway). Note trimmed of what the fields hold.
flags: Price gate: base $53 (Campspot Standard Back-in, one night, Nov 2026; full hookup $68) is over US$50, but gateways.py puts it 40 km from Great Smoky Mountains NP, so the gateway exception applies. No stays.
Standing 2-night minimum: Campspot refused one-night stays on Tuesdays in November and December 2026; recorded as min_stay always 2 (a 2-night standing minimum stays if marked).

The website's FAQ is template text from another campground: 'Yes, Rose Creek Campground is open year-round!', 'Rose Creek is primarily a vacation and short-term stay campground'. Campspot's contact email is hello@rootedretreatsnc.com and its park name is 'Gem City Campground - Franklin, NC'.
